exposure: elective cesarean section at the request of the patient
outcome: Hospitalization in the neonatal intensive care unit
finding: In low-risk parturients, obstetric interventions were associated with a lower prevalence of second- or third-degree perineal tears, while in high-risk pregnancies, interventions were associated with lower prevalence of neonatal and adult intensive care unit admissions, need for oxygen therapy, intracranial hemorrhage, and neonatal infection.
mod_finding: In low-risk pregnancies, interventions during labor were associated with a lower prevalence of second- or third-degree perineal tears.
